name: Signatureglobal (India) Ltd
title: Signatureglobal (India) Ltd - 543990 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Presales fell YoY to INR82.5bn and supply is pipelined at 6.5m sq ft; guidance calls for >INR150bn launches, INR100bn sales and INR50bn revenue, with net debt near zero.

triggers.label: Realisation up 20%+ to INR15,000/sq ft
triggers.quote: per square foot realization crossed INR15,000 mark, which is, of course, a 20% plus realization on a per square foot basis vis-a-vis the previous year

triggers.label: FY27 launches >INR150bn, sales >INR100bn
triggers.quote: we are estimating that we'll do new launches in excess of INR150 billion
triggers.highlight: new launches in excess of INR150 billion

triggers.label: FY26 presales down YoY at INR82.5bn
triggers.quote: there was a dip in presales
triggers.highlight: there was a dip in presales

triggers.label: Launches 6.5m sq ft; 12m sq ft near completion
triggers.quote: we are giving ourselves, let's say, just next 4 to 5 quarters to complete that entire stock

guidance.quote: we are estimating that we'll do new launches in excess of INR150 billion
we are hopeful of achieving sales in excess of INR100 billion
revenue recognition of INR50 billion, which means we'll have to do completions in the range of INR60 billion to INR65 billion
even collections, we are expecting it to cross INR50 billion in the year to come
you should assume capex in the range of about INR3,500 crores to INR4,000-odd crores should happen

guidance.value: Q1 ~2m sq ft; Q2-Q3 similar; Q4 ~2m sq ft
guidance.quote: The first launch is in quarter 1, which is roughly 2 million square foot

prior_guidance_check.quote: we ended at about INR4,000 crores
there was some -- there is some slippage into the current year

red_flags.label: FY26 collections and completions missed guidance
red_flags.quote: we ended at about INR4,000 crores

red_flags.label: Presales declined YoY; price-led realisation growth
red_flags.quote: there was a dip in presales

evasions.quote: it's more like once within twice shy situation
